author: Sanjog
review_text: Using eSewa for 4–5 years, but this has been my worst experience. On 17 July 2026, Rs. 1,000 was deducted from my linked bank account but never reflected in my wallet. My bank confirmed the transaction was successful. I immediately emailed support, raised a ticket, and called 5 times. Even after 3+ working days (80+ hours), the issue remains unresolved with only repeated false assurances. I'll quit eSewa once my refund is processed and won't recommend it.
